description: M2: Core Systems - Peg state shaders, mutation engine, synergies, and special peg behaviors

userStories.title: Peg State Shader
userStories.description: As a player, I want pegs to visually transform when their state changes so I can see the blessing/corruption axis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shaders/peg_state.gdshader
Uniform: corruption_level: float (0.0 = blessed gold, 0.5 = neutral, 1.0 = cursed crimson)
Uniform: mutation_pulse: float (animated sine, drives green pustule effect)
Uniform: void_factor: float (0.0-1.0, drives star-field overlay)
Interpolate visual: gold veins (0.0) → neutral (0.5) → crimson cracks (1.0)
Mutation pulse creates green pustule effect when corruption_level ≈ 0.5
Void factor adds star-field/void overlay
Apply ShaderMaterial to all peg types
Project compiles without errors in Godot
userStories.notes: Shader implemented with all required uniforms (corruption_level, mutation_pulse, void_factor). BasePeg.gd applies shader to all pegs via _setup_shader(). Project compiles successfully.

userStories.title: Mutation Engine Integration
userStories.description: As a player, I want pegs to mutate over time so my board evolves across encounters.
acceptanceCriteria: Wire MutationEngine to listen to EventBus.peg_hit
After MUTATION_THRESHOLD (5) hits, 15% chance per hit to shift peg state
State transitions: dormant → blessed/cursed → mutant → void
On state change: update peg shader uniforms + emit EventBus.peg_state_changed
Implement state transition rules: Dormant→Blessed/Cursed, Blessed→Mutant(30%), Cursed→Mutant(40%), Mutant→Void(10%)
Hit a peg 5+ times and verify it visibly mutates
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Synergy Checker Integration
userStories.description: As a player, I want synergies to activate when I have matching pegs so I can build powerful combos.
acceptanceCriteria: Wire SynergyChecker to EventBus.peg_state_changed and EventBus.peg_spawned
Maintain tag count dictionary: { death: 3, growth: 2, ... }
Check 5 synergies against tag counts: necrotic_bloom, cursed_flame, void_choir, bleeding_arch, profane_eye
Emit synergy_activated / synergy_broken / synergy_scaled as appropriate
Debug: print active synergies to console on any change
Place 3 Fungal + 3 Bone pegs manually and verify necrotic_bloom activates in console
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Special Peg Behaviors - Void Rift, Ember, Fungal
userStories.description: As a player, I want special pegs to have unique effects so strategic choices matter.
acceptanceCriteria: Void Rift Peg: on hit, queue_free ball, RunState.gold += 10
Ember Peg: on hit, iterate adjacent pegs within 150px, shift their corruption toward cursed by 0.1
Fungal Peg: after every 3 drops (RunState.total_drops % 3 == 0), check adjacent empty slots, 25% chance spawn Sprout
Each special behavior demonstrable in physics sandbox
Project compiles without errors in Godot
userStories.notes: VOID RIFT, EMBER, FUNGAL implemented. Oracle peg (ball splitting) is disabled - see US-005.

userStories.title: Special Peg Behavior - Oracle Ball Splitting
userStories.description: As a player, I want the Oracle peg to split balls so I can create powerful chain reactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Uncomment the ball-splitting code in scripts/game/pegs/OraclePeg.gd
On hit, spawn 2 additional balls at ±15° angle offset
Handle ball count limits to prevent performance issues
Test in physics sandbox to verify balls split correctly
Project compiles without errors in Godot
userStories.notes: NOTE: Implementation exists but is disabled. Need to uncomment and add ball count limits to prevent exponential ball multiplication. The splitting logic is at lines 34-69 in OraclePeg.gd, currently commented out at lines 20-27.

userStories.title: Corruption Spread Shader
userStories.description: As a player, I want corruption to visually spread across the board so the world reflects my choices.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shaders/corruption_spread.gdshader
Accept sampler2D corruption_map uniform (64x64 Image)
Shader bleeds/blurs the corruption map across background
Create CorruptionMapManager.gd to manage 64x64 Image
On peg_state_changed to cursed, paint circle on Image at peg position
Wire CorruptionMapManager to EventBus.peg_state_changed
Cursing a peg visibly spreads ink across the board background
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Ball Trail Effect
userStories.description: As a player, I want balls to leave a trail so I can see their path through the board.
acceptanceCriteria: Ball script maintains Array of last 20 positions
Line2D created for each ball, updated each frame from position array
Shader fades opacity: tail (0.0) → head (1.0)
Shader shifts color: white → ghost-blue
Ball leaves visible fading trail as it falls
Project compiles without errors in Godot
